item.description:
• Dreams are quicker and cheaper: the night skips memories it kept this week, links only what is new, and reuses its fixed prompts instead of paying for them again.
  • How I slept now says where the night's spend went, phase by phase.
  • The sleep quality dial names its default level and shows what each level costs.
  • Updating your kit shows real progress through every stage, and watching a dream no longer drops you back to the ready page.
  • Approval cards on Telegram survive a crash mid delivery, and a gate takes exactly one answer.
  • Every release now rehearses a full night before it ships, so a dream that could lose its connection never reaches you.
